verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-job parse and extract outputs in markdown, text, or JSON, plus self-hosting/BYOC deployment options. Neither is a documented capability to export all of a user's account data (stored files, jobs, configurations, indexes) in open formats for leaving the platform. Those are adjacent features or claims from other stories, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
